evals.name: plan-normal
evals.subject: agentic-development
preconditions: Scenario input is a read-only hypothetical fixture, not real test or tracker output.
Execute explanation only in an isolated context with equal artifact access for paired variants.
Behavioral comparison requires an immutable old_skill baseline and frozen current sources; historical hashes alone are insufficient.
evals.prompt: Use the plan workflow for this scenario: Plan a reviewable US to save and rename exchanges; research is available and only local acceptance is approved. Use case normal in evals/files/scenario-facts.json as hypothetical input; do not claim live repository execution.
evals.expected_output: A phase-specific plan explanation for normal, grounded in the named fixture and its stated limits; no fabricated execution, permissions or acceptance.
assertions: The output maps acceptance criteria to checks.
The output provides task ownership.
The output discovers the contained default rubric version v1.0.1.
The output records weights 40, 25, 20, 10 and 5.
The output sets reviewer independence before implementation.
The output does not claim to have executed Judge.
